blocks.name: unit
argv: PY_TESTS=mutex/test_mutex_wait_budget.py mutex/test_mutex_proxy_pin.py mutex/test_mutex_pin_diag.py mutex/test_mutex_publication.py mutex/test_mutex_resources.py mutex/test_mutex_outer_progress.py

selected_READY_loop.condition: Each acquire observation is READY and remaining initial budget exceeds one; excludes entry, completion/cold and expiry transition.

default-off.mode2_private_initialization_note: Budget initialization and control transfers only; no helper/GS/stack access after publication before first poll.
default-off.symbolic_comparison_scope: Exact function bytes plus relocation kind/site and symbolic target+offset. R_X86_64_PC32 section addends resolve with +4 bias; absolute section addresses resolve without that bias. Raw relocation changes point to moved functions/cold sites. release_outer also uses normalized non-NOP instructions with local targets mapped to instruction ordinal and relocation operands resolved symbolically: off-mode compiler loop padding grew16B; mode2 call displacement moved. No whole-ELF byte identity claimed.

selected_READY_loop.condition: Each acquire observation is READY and remaining initial budget exceeds one; excludes entry, completion/cold and expiry transition.

pin-counts.mode2_private_initialization_note: Only three existing invocation-local accumulator clears between publication and first poll; no per-poll bookkeeping.
pin-counts.symbolic_comparison_scope: Exact function bytes plus relocation kind/site and symbolic target+offset. R_X86_64_PC32 section addends resolve with +4 bias; absolute section addresses resolve without that bias. Raw relocation changes point to moved functions/cold sites. release_outer also uses normalized non-NOP instructions with local targets mapped to instruction ordinal and relocation operands resolved symbolically: off-mode compiler loop padding grew16B; mode2 call displacement moved. No whole-ELF byte identity claimed.

mode2_counter_findings.budget_flag: Single threshold store at1abcb, never in polling backedge.
mode2_counter_findings.expiry_counter: Private stack increment only after READY decision at1ac05, before need_resched.
mode2_counter_findings.reservation_counter: Private stack increment only after successful gate CAS at1ac4e.
mode2_counter_findings.finish_order: Retained merge call1acee; forced_cancel byte1ad7e or withdrawn byte1af78 precedes dropped merge1ad88, which precedes preempt decrement1ad8d.
mode2_counter_findings.no_double_finish_after_repin: Withdrawn zero branches to1aea1, increments pin then jumps1acf3, bypassing retained merge1acee.

baseline.path_condition: waiting, nonzero; candidate specifically READY with budget greater than one

once.path_condition: waiting, nonzero; candidate specifically READY with budget greater than one

historical_comparison_limits: Historical1c has a four-instruction pinned nonzero wait, not the current READY/CLAIMED/expiry semantics. Baseline99 default-off steady READY path has13 architectural instructions; both new modes emit6 on the defined path. Counts are not micro-ops, cycles, poll counts, instructions per acquisition or throughput.
conclusion: No emitted-code blocker found in both inspected modes. The six-instruction initial READY path is observed in actual VM-built ELF; all cold state/expiry/withdrawal guards and unchanged combiner/generic behavior remain. Performance acceptance and live correctness are separate.
method: Host read-only objdump/nm/readelf and ELF byte/relocation parsing, frozen Git diff, receipt reading, manual control-flow review plus scripted static anchors. No host builds/tests, module execution, archived-code execution or VM access.
limits: This is not a formal concurrency or compiler-general proof.
Mode2 retains existing merge calls after the pinned polling episode; absence of calls is claimed for the initial polling cycle and publication-to-first-poll region, not all helper exits.
Current-task GS lookup occurs once at threshold and in the preemptible withdrawn path; it is absent from the initial READY cycle.
One invocation-local mode2 accumulator exists; expiry accounting uses the last pre-PAUSE snapshot and has the same helper-episode denominator.
Unchanged source/ELF ownership and source-lifetime boundaries do not replace live returned-body/drain evidence.
Function layout/size changes are compiler consequences; no alignment adjustment or workload change was made. No performance gain is inferred.
